The hash identifies the thumbnail.

movingSamples.name: Big Buck Bunny (1:44.5 to 2:14.5)
movingSamples.author: Blender Foundation
movingSamples.note: 30-second cut at 24 frames per second with its own sound. Depth Anything V2 Small estimated depth on all 720 frames at a 196-pixel model side; offline alignment, filtering, and edge stabilization are baked into the MP2D byte cache. tools/cdx-mp2-samples.mjs makes the files. Explicitly picked; neither file loads with the default sample. Archive live record declares CC BY; original Blender pages returned HTTP 403 in this environment. Made by Ryan with Codex (GPT-6), derived from the Blender Foundation film; the film and its derived depth keep CC BY. Round 4 depth-only rebuild on October 16, 2026: tools/cdx-mp2-r4-bake.mjs seeks inside every original source frame, uses one clip-wide depth range and the existing upload refinement’s symmetric, color-gated half-second window (radius 12), and keeps the original video bytes. Baked key times are i / 24. The derived cache retains the film’s CC BY license. Losslessly gzip-compressed by tools/cdx-mp2-r4-compress.mjs; unpacking restores every original MP2D byte, with unchanged depth resolution, precision, frame count, and license.

A photoreal fictional tabletop still life: one clear drinking glass half filled with water in the foreground, two matte terracotta spheres behind it on pale oak, a small blue ceramic cube farther back; visible refraction through the glass and water, delicate highlights, oblique view, soft side window light. Clear spatial separation, crisp geometry.
